new_result.statement: With a_i=D_i+lambda z_i^2, G_ij=max(z_i^2 D_j^2 a_j^2,z_j^2 D_i^2 a_i^2), K_P=sum p_ij q_ij G_ij, if K_P>0 then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 8 (lambda^2 E K_P)^(-1/8).

exact_endpoint_sharpening: If K_D=K_P=0 then every active edge with both z endpoints nonzero has D_i=D_j=0; an active zero-z endpoint exposes an exact invertible hyperbolic pair whose Schur elimination preserves the full rank-one-leaf block.
